name: Kalshi BTC probability momentum
description: Causal probability-point returns of the bound Kalshi market's own btc.kalshi.prediction_quote affirmative_midpoint over ten-second, one-minute, and five-minute horizons on a one-second causal sample ring. The affirmative_midpoint is a probability in [0,1]; return_pp_10s, return_pp_1m, and return_pp_5m are one hundred times the change in that probability over each horizon, so they are expressed in probability points. direction_1m is down, flat, or up from the full-precision one-minute probability-point return, with flat meaning exactly zero and no dead band. The ring is scoped to one market_generation: a window or generation roll resets it and restarts the warm-up, because a new market is a new series. Any missing or non-ready one-second observation breaks continuity and restarts the warm-up; the identity is ready only once the ring holds 301 contiguous one-second samples (the longest horizon, five minutes). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
